content.heading: Vehicle leasing solution with defined rentals and bundled services.
content.text: KMPL Car Lease offers a structured leasing solution that enables customers to use a vehicle for a defined tenure against fixed monthly rentals. The product is designed for eligible salaried individuals and corporate programs, with options that may include vehicle registration, insurance, and other services, subject to specific terms and conditions.
